review_title: Damaged on arrival and wrong color sent!
review_text: I ordered black headphones, but received silver ones with a cracked headband. The packaging was torn and the charging cable was missing. Completely unacceptable for a premium product.

review_title: Charged twice on UPI but order shows failed
review_text: Money was deducted twice from my bank account via Google Pay (₹1,24,999 each time), but the website gave an error and the order was never confirmed. Customer care is not answering.

review_title: Courier delayed package for 8 days in hub
review_text: The tracking status has been stuck at the Mumbai transit hub for 8 days without any movement. Promised delivery was April 1st, now it is over a week late and no one is helping.

review_title: Returned item 18 days ago, still no refund!
review_text: The delivery agent picked up the returned defective vacuum 18 days ago and return was approved. However, the refund of ₹45,000 has still not credited to my original payment card.

review_title: Screen flickering and overheating after iOS update
review_text: The display started flickering intermittently after 2 days of usage. Device heats up rapidly during normal video playback. Need immediate technical assistance or replacement.

review_title: Outstanding battery life and crisp display
review_text: Extremely satisfied with the delivery and display clarity. Battery lasts for weeks on a single charge. Highly recommended.

review_title: Duplicate transaction hold still not cleared
review_text: Another customer affected by the payment gateway glitch. Bank says merchant must release authorization hold. Please reverse the duplicate charge immediately.
